purpose: Close the generated clothes-support assembly over the actual DanchiHighDetail LOD chain. LOD0 must contain every physical source component, LOD1 keeps the support arm plus receiver/plate/pivot, LOD2 keeps only the load-bearing support-arm silhouette, and LOD3 removes the sub-pixel hardware. Animated cross-fade remains mandatory. This is source/runtime readiness QA only and awards no Visual Fidelity points.
sourceIssue: The generated hardware refinement can add plate/pivot/anchor renderers after an existing Danchi LODGroup has already been built, so stale ownership still requires closure. The earlier generic-'Bracket'-before-'ClothesBracket' classifier precedence defect is now fixed in QualityBlockDanchiLodUpgrade: the specific ClothesBracket medium-detail rule runs first, so a clean rebuild naturally retains all 340 mm support arms through LOD2. Explicit promotion remains only as compatibility repair for a persisted scene produced before that source fix.

temporalPolicy.rationale: The 340 mm support arm remains a readable facade silhouette after the 90 mm receiver and centimetre-scale mounting hardware become sub-pixel. Smaller circular/fastener geometry is removed earlier to reduce shimmer rather than being kept as unstable distant pixels.
